Acoustic Evidence Report
Dunakeszi 2025-10-20 · Drone Signal Analysis
Training distribution vs measured frequencies — domain gap visualisation
⚠
Domain gap detected. The drone acoustic model was trained on BPF fundamentals of 80–360 Hz (Mavic Pro/2/Mini, generic quad) mapped to mel bands 2–8. All extracted Dunakeszi segments show dominant energy at 34–62 Hz (mel band 1–2) — altitude-dependent blade slowdown pushes the fundamental below the training distribution. The CNN scores 0.03–0.04 (near-random) because it never saw this frequency regime. Heuristic scores 0.73–0.83 correctly confirm drone presence from harmonic structure alone. Fix: add dji_high_altitude BPF profile (30–90 Hz) and retrain.
